notes.title: New SHAPES update 🧩🧩
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! We wanted to share new features that affect the spawn shapes of units that enter the battlefield.[/h3]

Previously we had 5 shapes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/de508f41b4e15d057b4c84c28f130e61ba37d96d.png[/img]

[h3]We decided to add 2 more. Here's what came out of it.[/h3]
L with a spacer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/b28a6074b0ed0cb42bfb052df819ef739e3ec4bc.gif[/img]
Square.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/8b350592ca08764d6bf0e9c7ecb4fc949f5c1883.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW PREDICTOR[/h3]
We also decided to improve [b] the predictor of the next shape[/b]. Now it shows not only what the next shape will be, but also what unit classes will be in it. This will give players who like to calculate moves in advance more information to make the right decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/1f29e20aa7c104c6419c3104271b192cbbe9fbd7.gif[/img]

We hope you like these ideas! 
Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: This is how we grow our trogls!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/bf0c03afc3d30811adc3dbf555a3fe03f9ec23be.png[/img]

[b]Step A[/b]
So! A quick guide to raising [b]trogles [/b] in March March Caves!
We decided that we needed an individual stuffed with spores as much as possible and developed several sketches for a zombified trogl.

[b]Step B[/b]
Now we need to pick a sketch and render it. For that we're using Photoshop. We also need to draw each limb/body piece. That way we will be able to use it for skeletal animation in Spine.



[b]Step C[/b]
After Photoshop file with layers is ready, we export it to Spine and begin the [b]rigging[/b] stage.
To put it simply, rigging includes all the preparations for subsequent animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/c02c82143fec379433fd151e461fcf70b5bf0a93.gif[/img]

[h2]After the animations are done, our zombie will truly come to life and will be able to crawl to the battlefield[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/86b26b0981ca66f00a9f3d6465f38e1626e9e58a.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Hero Class!
notes.content:
[h1]Meet the new hero – the Alchemist![/h1]

As a child, she could not get along with other children... So after growing up, she decided that she would make her own friends. The Alchemist's unique ability is [b]HOMUNCULUS SUMMONING[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/6b4765ddcd4efac3bf5d94d9affbb967dfd74295.gif[/img]

At first, the Homunculus cannot boast of high stats, but over time you can turn it into a real [b]MONSTER[/b], tailored to your gaming strategy.
Each level-up, in addition to the Alchemist's new hero skill, you also have a free Homunculus power-up! You increase its characteristics or give it new abilities. Tooth spit, Viscous saliva, Colossal fist... in this cruel world, you need special friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/cc78d7c1cb1d82965e3f88b0f84d051c2fab6b62.png[/img]

Several variations of homunculus bodies, and each is beautiful and unique.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/9bcadcbc6fcdc1ca1ca862be393d8d47d57262f8.png[/img]


Isn't it cute?!

We have some interesting ideas for a 4th hero, but we've decided to focus on new enemies and interesting combat modifiers for now.

See you soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/96711dd38539d63a3e25accd0eee26bbf84b5422.gif[/img]

notes.title: Light Magic!
notes.content:
For the past few months, we have not published any news, but we have been actively developing the game. And today we want to share with you some new stuff!

[h2][b]Let's talk about magic today![/b][/h2]

Initially, we planned that the game would have four schools of magic: fire, water, earth, and air. We added the fifth school of magic - [b]Light[/b]. This will allow to expand the magical capabilities of the [b]Paladin[/b] hero class.

Light spells cannot boast of great destructive power but extend the life of allied units. Here are some of those spells:

[list]
[*][h3][b]Sunspot[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/ecf2ca6b2431b11f1a4170291e9db372772e2941.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hFs5dIk.gif[/img]
[i]Make your warriors feel comfy[/i]
Reinforces a cell in your half of the battlefield. Allies that are standing on it recover 1 hit point each turn. Duration - 5 turns

[*][h3][b]Wisp[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/a0e12e22b8775fc237034f91db7f8c30d2c9aa3a.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EsJlQ7Y.gif[/img]
[i]Small and bold[/i]
Summons a wisp (2 HP, 1 Damage). When killed, the Whisp stuns the enemy in front of it.

[*][h3][b]Inner Energy[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/eeca0b7cae24336eda149bfea649181091cff57f.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tx8a7eS.gif[/img]
[i]Army on steroids[/i]
An ally's maximum HP is increased by 2 hit points.

[*][h3][b]Blinding Light[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/85cc96d88f2efcbe1036471f9f84f9bf3a31951e.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qKTSqjo.gif[/img]
[i]Squint heretics![/i]
The enemy unit gets a chance to miss his attacks.
[/list]

Next time we will tell you about our new hero class - the [b]Alchemist![/b] And his companion - [strike]adorable[/strike] homunculus 😉

All the best,
Lepka games team

notes.title: Demo (v.021) Patchnotes
notes.content:
Thanks for checking the new demo, everyone!!!

After the release of the new demo version, we've been fixing a few bugs and adding some features based on your feedback! Here are some of the changes:

- [b]Added:[/b] a screen before the game that shows what units you and your opponent have (to better understand what will spawn each turn on the opponent's side)
- [b]Added:[/b] Cell is now highlighted once hovered
- [b]Added:[/b] If you hover over a unit, you can see the targets of his attack
- [b]Added:[/b] Animations of In-battle hero UI for the start of the battle and for receiving moral damage
- [b]Added:[/b] Spawn animation for the first 12 swordsmen at the start of the battle.
- [b]Added:[/b] [b]LEADERBOARD[/b] (based on time) + now you can see your best result at the bottom.
- [b]Added:[/b] You can now see where the enemy will put his units in the next turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/8737b07e1392b44b2b2d101194a3e105c73e79ec.gif[/img]

-[b]Changed:[/b] Ghose evasion is 15% instead of 30%
-[b]Changed:[/b] 3rd mission: now you have to hold for 12 turns instead of 15.
-[b]Removed:[/b] support enemy units from the 2nd battle.
-[b]Reworked:[/b] Revelry
           Was: all your units have a 15% miss chance
           Now: 25% of spawned units have a 20% miss chance and +1 damage

-New demo is now translated into [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] and [b]Portuguese[/b]!

-A lot of minor bugs were fixed.

If you have any more suggestions or feedback, please leave them here or through the in-game survey.
We will be focusing on the content of the full game,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342821/7177666d57ef261d0f316de710e58faa8d61ff96.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW Demo-version is out!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings! [/b]
We have been working hard on an improved version of the single-player mode and we are ready to show you the new Demo! Now we are a few steps closer to the roguelike genre!
We removed endless mode for now but the story mode is now UPGRADED

[b]New features added:[/b]
- Global map
- 2 Heroes to choose from
- Heroes can level up and get passive and active skills.
- 10 Spells
- Army progression on the map
- New enemy units: Ghost, Vampire, Hammerer, Bat, and Witch.
- Enemy Heroes have Skills
- AND MORE!

Come try it out NOW!!! And let us know what you think and how we can improve the game.

notes.title: Demo version patch 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Within a week after uploading the demo, we received a lot of useful feedback! After the corresponding changes, the game has become more friendly for new players. We want to keep improving the game. Therefore, if you have any suggestions or questions, welcome to our discord server!
List of changes:
- The turn time has been significantly increased.
- Added the ability to end a turn by pressing a key.
- Added tutorial
- Chance of unit spawn changed
- Fixed minor bugs
